analyst.summary: ACME Solar is a fast-growing renewable power producer with long-term contracted revenue, but its returns on capital (under 9% ROCE) are modest for a stock trading at over 44 times earnings and more than 4 times book value, and the business carries close to Rs 20,000 crore of debt to fund its expansion. The promoter also reduced its stake by nearly 12 percentage points in the most recent quarter. We rate this a Sell given the valuation is ahead of what the returns currently justify.
